proof_body:
by
  intro d A B h
  have hA : A % 4 = 0 ∨ A % 4 = 1 ∨ A % 4 = 2 ∨ A % 4 = 3 := by omega
  have hB : B % 4 = 0 ∨ B % 4 = 1 ∨ B % 4 = 2 ∨ B % 4 = 3 := by omega
  have hmod : (A ^ 2 - d * B ^ 2) % 4 = 0 := Int.emod_eq_zero_of_dvd h
  constructor
  · intro hd
    rcases hd with hd | hd <;> rcases hA with hA | hA | hA | hA <;> rcases hB with hB | hB | hB | hB <;>
      simp [pow_two, Int.sub_emod, Int.mul_emod, hA, hB, hd] at hmod <;> omega
  · intro hd
    rcases hA with hA | hA | hA | hA <;> rcases hB with hB | hB | hB | hB <;>
      simp [pow_two, Int.sub_emod, Int.mul_emod, hA, hB, hd] at hmod <;> omega
